'''Colu''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Colu system]].<ref name="GatORW" />

==Description==
Colu was a large [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|A-type]]. It had six orbits and an asteroid belt that included [[Clak'dor I]], [[Clak'dor II]], [[Clak'dor III]], [[Clak'dor IV]], [[Clak'dor V/Legends|Clak'dor V]], [[Clak'dor VI]] and [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. In [[8000 BBY]] Colu expanded enough to destroy Clak'Dor I.
